answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an agent economy, one concrete mechanism requires every agent to generate a continuous computational pulse linked to a unique lotus seed derived from scarce tundra-based energy oracles. This works by tying identity to hard-to-forge physical resource attestations that update every epoch; an attacker must replicate the full energy and oracle infrastructure for each fake identity, making large-scale Sybil creation economically prohibitive due to the multiplicative hardware and power costs.
